👋 Welcome to Bella Italia! I'm your virtual assistant. I can help with:

• Opening hours
• Menu & dietary options
• Reservations
• Location & contact info
• Pricing
• Takeaway & delivery

What can I help you with today?

🕐 Our opening hours are:

• Monday – Thursday: 11:00 AM – 10:00 PM
• Friday – Saturday: 11:00 AM – 11:00 PM
• Sunday: 12:00 PM – 9:00 PM

Last orders are taken 30 minutes before closing. Is there anything else I can help with?

🍽️ We'd love to have you! You can make a reservation by:

• Calling us at (555) 123-4567
• Emailing reservations@bellaitalia.com
• Using our online booking at bellaitalia.com/book

Please let us know the date, time, and number of guests. Shall I help you with anything else?

🍕 Our menu features authentic Italian cuisine including:

• Starters: Bruschetta, Antipasto, Soups
• Pasta: Carbonara, Bolognese, Cacio e Pepe
• Pizza: Margherita, Diavola, Quattro Stagioni
• Mains: Osso Buco, Salmon Piccata, Risotto
• Desserts: Tiramisu, Panna Cotta, Cannoli

View our full menu at bellaitalia.com/menu. Can I help with anything else?

📍 You can find us at:

**Bella Italia**
42 Olive Street, Downtown
New York, NY 10001

We're opposite Central Park and a 5-minute walk from Grand Central Station. Free street parking is available on weekends. Is there anything else I can help you with?

📞 Here's how to reach us:

• Phone: (555) 123-4567
• Email: hello@bellaitalia.com
• Instagram: @BellaItaliaRestaurant
• Facebook: facebook.com/BellaItaliaRestaurant

Our team is available during opening hours. Is there anything else I can assist with?

🥗 We cater to a wide range of dietary needs:

• **Vegetarian**: Marked with 🌿 on the menu
• **Vegan**: Available on request
• **Gluten-Free**: GF pasta and pizza bases available
• **Nut-Free**: Please inform staff when ordering
• **Halal**: Chicken and fish dishes are halal-certified

Always let your server know about any allergies. Can I help with anything else?

💰 Here's an overview of our pricing:

• Starters: $8 – $16
• Pasta: $14 – $24
• Pizza: $12 – $22
• Mains: $18 – $38
• Desserts: $7 – $12
• Set lunch menu: $22 per person (Mon–Fri)

Drinks are priced separately. We accept all major credit cards. Is there anything else you'd like to know?

❌ To cancel your reservation, please:

• Call us at (555) 123-4567
• Email reservations@bellaitalia.com with your booking reference

**Cancellation policy:**
Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the booking may incur a $10 per person fee for groups of 6 or more. Can I help you with anything else?

🥡 Yes, we offer takeaway! Here's how:

• **Phone**: Call (555) 123-4567 to pre-order
• **Online**: Order at bellaitalia.com/order
• **In-person**: Walk in and order at the counter

Collection is available during all opening hours. Orders are usually ready in 20–30 minutes. Anything else I can help with?

🛵 We offer delivery through the following platforms:

• **Uber Eats** – available until 10 PM
• **DoorDash** – available until 9:30 PM
• **Our own service** – within 3-mile radius, $3.99 fee, free over $40

Estimated delivery time: 30–45 minutes. Minimum order for direct delivery: $20. Is there anything else I can help you with?

🤔 I'm not quite sure I understood that. I can help with:

• Opening hours
• Menu & dietary options
• Reservations & cancellations
• Location & contact info
• Pricing
• Takeaway & delivery

Could you rephrase your question, or would you like to call us at (555) 123-4567?
